basis: The named replication report and explicit main effect of Condition identify the own-name versus different-name P3b contrast. The report transcription prints partial eta squared .01 from a multi-factor Time × Channel × Condition design. The requested metric is the literal unrecognised label et; neither its intended definition nor equivalence to partial eta squared is established. Do not reinterpret et as an ordinary eta/eta-squared code or use numerical agreement to establish metric identity.
source_header: The XML-transcription header explains the partial-eta notation; it is provenance/transcription metadata, not an independently authored methodological definition.
source_limits: One-page report version2 does not reconcile the p6 locator and does not provide variance components to transform metrics. No transformation or inferred analytic N is adopted.
